decision: Adopt one isolated compact-only report repair, preserving the failed source stage.
scope_adjudication: Strict comparator accepts already-parsed, SHA-bound JSON values from the existing committed writer. Do not extend old parsers; duplicate-name untrusted JSON text is outside this interface.
Use eight tiny in-memory comparison regressions plus the actual unique 514-record report entry; no redundant miniature report fixture or extra data pass.

Execution has a continuous 120-second cap with 110-second worker and ten-second cleanup inside it. The later independent 514-compact acceptance pass has a separate 120-second bound; static review is outside these clocks.
Source/model/official identity hashing reads bytes only; no model loading, inference, numerical input decode or original stream access.
